testimonials.quote: We asked for a quote. We received a philosophy.
testimonials.author: Prospective Client

testimonials.quote: Delivery was on time. I have been unable to establish what the plan was.
testimonials.author: Programme Manager

testimonials.quote: The documentation is excellent. It is also longer than the software.
testimonials.author: Technical Writer

testimonials.quote: I asked what the roadmap was. They told me the absence of a plan is the plan. Twice.
testimonials.author: Concerned Investor

testimonials.quote: I requested a minor website change. Three days later they had built a game engine.
testimonials.author: Former Client

testimonials.quote: Technically they delivered everything we asked for. This somehow made the experience worse.
testimonials.author: Disappointed Customer

testimonials.quote: They are using our staging cluster. We do not have a contract with them.
testimonials.author: Platform Engineer

testimonials.quote: They refactored the invoice.
testimonials.author: Accounts Payable

testimonials.quote: I don't work here. They keep putting me on the website.
testimonials.author: Kevin

testimonials.quote: I cannot determine what they sell. My analysis is ongoing.
testimonials.author: Anonymous Enterprise Architect

testimonials.quote: Their agents opened forty issues overnight. Two of them were mine.
testimonials.author: Maintainer of a Neighbouring Repository

testimonials.quote: They came to our village. We now have observability.
testimonials.author: Peasant

testimonials.quote: Their deployment process frightens me, and I have fought Thanos.
testimonials.author: Thor

testimonials.quote: I find their lack of project management disturbing.
testimonials.author: Darth Vader

testimonials.quote: Hire them, you should not.
testimonials.author: Yoda

testimonials.quote: Four score and seven abstractions ago, this was a small change.
testimonials.author: Abraham Lincoln

testimonials.quote: I have read their contract. It is longer than mine.
testimonials.author: Lucifer

testimonials.quote: I gave humanity free will. SubZeroDev is making me reconsider.
testimonials.author: God

testimonials.quote: Vision doc says "two kinds ship in v1"; the repository ships three
testimonials.author: SubZeroDev.GameEngine — GitHub Issue #212

testimonials.quote: You declined to predict a single thing. This is, statistically, the single most reasonable choice available in this entire campaign, and reasonable was never really the point.
testimonials.author: What Would Lucifer Do?

testimonials.quote: Lucifer, for what it's worth, would probably respect this. Briefly. Then he'd build something about it.
testimonials.author: What Would Lucifer Do?

testimonials.author: What Would Lucifer Do?
